title: Creamy Dutch Noodle Bake
description: A rich and comforting dish that combines the flavors of the Netherlands with the simplicity of a home-cooked noodle bake.
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, cook bacon until crispy.
Add sliced onions to the skillet and cook until softened.
Stir in velvety white sauce and bring to a simmer.
In a large baking dish, combine cooked noodles, white sauce mixture, and grated cheese.
Top with chopped parsley and crumbled bacon.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
